Residents:
Yuki (50s, WFH): Weekdays 9:00-17:30 at desk_b1. Often out for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s, Office): Weekdays out ~8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.

Object Locations & Movements:

- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Nora’s skincare/toiletry bag on shelf; razor on sink; towels on rack.

- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Dog leash, hat on hook. Keys, wallet on table. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dishes in cupboard/sink. Dog bowl on floor. Dog food in pantry.
- Living: Standard furniture items (couch, table, shelf).

Dynamic Items (Wednesday Update):
At 00:00, both residents were home. Yuki returned from an evening outing (gym/running), bringing back gym bag, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, umbrella, wallet, and water bottle to the entryway. Nora’s work items (backpack, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, water bottle, scarf, sunglasses, wallet) were also in the entryway from the previous night.

At 08:00, Nora left for work, taking her work items (backpack, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, water bottle, scarf, sunglasses, wallet, phone, shoes, jacket) OUT_OF_HOUSE. Yuki remained home.

At 12:00, Yuki was at desk_b1 with mug, tablet, and water bottle.

At 16:00, Yuki moved mug, plate, and water bottle to sink_k1.

At 20:00, Nora returned home. Her work items were redistributed: backpack, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet to entryway; laptop, notebook, pen, phone to bedroom_2; lunchbox, water bottle to kitchen. Yuki’s items were also organized: gym bag to desk_b1; hat to dresser_b1; shoes to shoe_rack_e1; wallet to entry_table_e1; water bottle to dish_rack_k1. Kitchen items (knife, pan, pot, spatula) were on counter_k1, suggesting meal preparation. Dog food bag was on floor_k_k1.

Current Status (Wed 23:59):
- Yuki: Home. Items are in their usual spots (desk, entry, kitchen).
- Nora: Home. Items are in their usual spots (bedroom, entry, kitchen).
- Dog: Home.

Notes:
- Yuki’s routine involves taking specific items (gym bag, running shoes, jacket, umbrella, keys, wallet, water bottle) when leaving for exercise or errands.
- Nora’s work items (laptop, backpack, lunchbox, etc.) are brought home in the evening and left in the entryway, then moved to their respective rooms.
